Tessa (Marketing): Quick thread to lock landing hero + launch posts for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. Need short hero lines, two CTA variants, and webinar routing.
Jon (Growth): routing: hosted -> self-serve signups; dedicated -> demo request (SDR queue); private -> enterprise contact. Add hidden webinar field 'deployment_interest'.
Maya (PM): webinar scheduled Mon 11am PT. Slides: latency, cost/token, p95 tail + one app example (vector search, 6k tokens). Keep numbers conservative.
Owen (Design): proposed hero strings:
- Hosted: "Ship features in hours. Self-serve API."
- Dedicated: "Predictable throughput for production."
- Private: "Run inference inside your VPC."
Tessa (Marketing): tweak Hosted to "Ship LLM features in hours" (no period). For tri-banner hero: "One API. Any deployment. Predictable inference."
Jon (Growth): social posts:
- Short/X: "One API. Any deployment. See latency & cost benchmarks live: <link>"
- LinkedIn: slightly expanded with migration playbook CTA.
Maya (PM): please include form question: "Which deployment are you evaluating?" values: hosted/dedicated/private. Map to lead tags.

```json
{"utm_campaign":"tri-launch","interest":"dedicated","use_case":"embeddings"}
```
Owen (Design): CTA A/B test: "Register — See Benchmarks" vs "Register — Get Migration Playbook". I'll add variant IDs.
Tessa (Marketing): draft landing microcopy: "Ship LLM features fast with Redwood Inference. Use a single API across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private deployments. Choose Hosted to move fast, Dedicated for predictable throughput, or Private to keep inference inside your VPC. Register for our webinar to see benchmark demos and a migration playbook."
Jon (Growth): trim for hero: "One API. Any deployment. Predictable performance." works.
